name: Vally
description: Evaluates AI agents, MCP servers, skills and CLIs: lints specs, runs evals, grades full trajectories and compares runs with Microsoft's Vally CLI, for developers testing agents locally or in CI.

skills.name: Run Evals
skills.description: Runs prompts and tasks against an agent, MCP server or CLI, records each trajectory of turns, tool calls and tokens, and grades it.

skills.name: Lint Specs and Skills
skills.description: Checks SKILL.md files and eval specs statically for problems before anything runs, with no agent run required.

skills.name: Re-grade Trajectories
skills.description: Re-grades saved trajectories without re-running the agent, and verifies graders against a golden patch with no agent run.

skills.name: Compare and Experiment
skills.description: Compares a treatment run against a baseline with an LLM judge and runs multi-variant experiments to collect comparable results.

skills.name: Results Dashboard
skills.description: Starts an analytics server and dashboard for eval results, and imports results into SQLite for historical tracking.
